status: architecture and offline consensus pilot; no teacher inference executed
scope: Polish printed and historical full-page documents; layout development only

ontology.level: page regions; line segmentation remains a separate downstream task

boundaries.teacher_identity: one vote per teacher.id per page; prompt or run variants do not add votes

next_gate: Run a small private multi-teacher pilot on development pages, inspect class balance and disagreement, then freeze teacher revisions and thresholds before generating training labels.
claim_boundary: The module creates traceable weak labels and an RF-DETR-compatible COCO file. It is not evidence that RF-DETR improves OCR or that SLAYER-OCR is SOTA.
